report.explanation: All 12 checkout observations returned 200 with durations 63-172ms; metrics show /v1/checkout 502 count of 0 and p95 ~247ms. No errors or clear failure signal exist, and dependency-level metrics are empty, so no public cause (http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak, bad-configuration) is substantiated. Need dependency-level latency/error data and a baseline to determine if this is even an incident.
missing_evidence: Per-dependency latency/error metrics for order->inventory, order->payment, order->postgresql, inventory->redis to localize the latency source
Order and downstream service logs/traces for the same checkout window to attribute the ~125-175ms tail
Baseline latency SLO/threshold to determine whether observed checkout durations are anomalous at all
